after.sourceAndNew: Widespread random forgetting is preserved from originalP321. The following finite record, cadence and recovery procedure is NEW authorship for review.
after.scope: The phenomenon affects bards across Aethel, including eligible people encountered outside the three initial witnesses. Track the actual characters encountered in play; the Director need not fabricate a complete world population or grant unseen losses as research evidence. It is not restricted to the Bard class if an established NPC is a professional bard in the fiction.
after.record: Before a tracked bard’s first roll, record at least one actually established mundane melody they know and any surviving written or recorded copies. Do not invent additional forgotten melodies, class techniques or lost memories as a reward for repeated checks. The three initial musicians each have a fixed four-tune repertoire recorded below.
after.cadence: At the first recorded local sunset after module activation, then every24elapsed hours for that bard while the strand is attached, choose uniformly among that bard’s currently remembered recorded mundane melodies. Use a die with enough equally likely faces and reroll out-of-range values; never choose a favored result after rolling. With no eligible remembered melody, no additional loss occurs. Record the exact tune and event timestamp; changed location, new session or repeated introduction never adds another event.
after.effect: The bard cannot reproduce that particular tune from memory. They retain class cards, spell repertoire, language, instrument skill, unrelated memories and agency. They can follow an actual legible score or playable recording with the ordinary access and sensory requirements. This grants no translation or ability to hear in silence.
after.relearning: Ten uninterrupted active minutes studying an actual surviving score or hearing an actual knowledgeable willing teacher restores one named mundane melody, no check. This is training and is not halved byTransition. A later scheduled loss can select it again; the10minutes do not move the next event timestamp. With no surviving source, the specific tune remains forgotten until an actual source is found.
after.playerParticipation: Respect the actual session-zero agreement on memory themes. A player can use abstract labels such as TuneA instead of describing an emotionally significant song. If that theme is excluded, keep its consequences on the widespread NPC phenomenon and use an agreed neutral witness role for that PC; do not erase actual class powers to enforce participation.

before: Issuer: Veyr of the Second Margin, licensed courier for the Canian engine patent office. This local license grants only the powers written here; it does not speak for every devil or mortal court.

Offer: the named claimant receives one personal copy of three finite Canian maintenance plates and permission to use the three demonstration procedures printed on them. This conveys no soul, allegiance, inherited property, class proficiency, spell, feat or authority over others.

Term and bond: consent begins when the claimant knowingly signs or makes an understood witnessed mark on this exact displayed document and deposits50gp of actual coins in the office lockbox. If the coins are unavailable, no term begins; discussion, negotiation and refusal remain available. The first contradiction is due400 elapsed24-hour days after that instant; later dues are every400suchdays while the term continues. This contract explicitly chooses Aethel civil years. Session count, primordial Cycles and Descent openings do not alter it. The50gp bond stays the claimant’s identifiable deposited sum until a printed forfeiture; it is not new money or permission to take other property.

Delivery: before each dueinstant, place one written fictional contradiction statement in the public quartzpanel slot, or dictate it to Veyr during an arranged public meeting. The statement identifies two mutually incompatible claims, identifies one actual observed record that supports each claim, and states one concrete question that could help reconcile them. No real-player secret or belief is required. A discovered error may be acknowledged honestly; knowingly fabricated evidence does not qualify.

Review: the slot holds the actual paper in a visible accessible drawer. Within24 elapsedhours Veyr issues a numbered receipt stating whether each of the three fields is present and how the cited records conflict. An on-time submission is provisionally timely while review occurs. A rejection must name the absent or nonconflicting field; the claimant has10days from notice to correct it, even if the originaldueinstant has passed. Timely accepted correction satisfies that year once.

Examples: recordA says a sealed chamber was empty atnoon; recordB shows a namedwitness insideatnoon; question askswhether eitherclock wasmisread. Or the samepublishedproof assertsboth thatallgatekeysareiron andthatoneacceptedgatekeyisglass; question askswhich premise fails. Merely assertingrain andsun occurredon differentdays isnot a contradiction. These examplesmayguide form but cannot countas inventedobservedcampaignrecords.

Departure: the claimant may end the term atanytime by an understood declaration toVeyr or a signedstatement in the panel. If the current annual obligation has already been accepted, the office returns the actual50gp bond and the term ends. Otherwise the claimant may submit an actual qualifying statement now, or choose immediate departure by forfeiting that50gp bond. This is the complete exit cost. Previously delivered papers remain archived. Ending the term ends demonstration-bench permission, but retained knowledge, the personal paper copy, soul, memories, hitpoints, class abilities and unrelated property are not taken or erased.

Missed obligation: if neither an on-time submission nor a within-grace correction occurs, the term ends, the office keeps the actual50gp bond, and demonstration-bench permission ends. No additional supernaturalcurse, compulsorymission, death, unboundeddebt or retroactiveoathbreach follows. This is the complete default consequence. The claimant is warned of the due date, grace period and forfeiture before signature.

Refusal: no termbegins. Veyr mayoffer the separate free-will exercise below, whichmayalso be declined without penalty. Silence, coercion, incapacity, deception aboutthe actualterms and anotherperson’ssignature do notcreateconsent.

Amendment: no hiddenclause. An amendmentrequires theclaimant’s explicit informedagreement toanewcompletewrittenversion beforetakingeffect. Veyr cannotalter a runningdeadline orclaim afterthefact. Destructionofpanel doesnotcreateaway tofulfill; a claimant can arrange an actualpublicdeliverytoVeyr with the samewrittenreceipt. Ifissuerunavailablethroughduedate, timelyrecordedattemptwithpaper retained grants10daysafteractual renewedavailability to deliver; it nevercreates infinitefreebenchcharges.
after: Issuer: Veyr of the Second Margin, licensed courier for the Canian engine patent office. This local license grants only the powers written here. It does not speak for every devil or mortal court.

Offer and title: the named claimant is designated heir to the office’s three specified engine patents, CF-1 Isolation, CF-2 External Cooling Loop and CF-3 Pressure Seal. Acceptance registers this limited present title, gives one personal paper copy of all three plates, and permits their stated demonstration procedures. The title grants no past ancestry, other estate, soul claim, class proficiency, spell, feat or authority over other people. Its rights apply only to these named office records and the printed local bench arrangement.

Term and bond: informed signature or an understood witnessed mark on this exact document, together with deposit of50gp in actual coins, begins the term at timestampT0. Without the actual deposit no term begins. The first contradiction is due atT0+400elapsed24hour days, the next atT0+800days, and so on while the term continues. This contract chooses Aethel civil years. Descent openings, primordial Cycles, travel and session count do not change these deadlines. The50gp bond remains identifiable held property until a printed return or forfeiture.

Delivery: submit one fictional contradiction for each annual record by placing its written statement in the public quartz-panel slot or dictating it to Veyr at an actual public meeting. Identify two mutually incompatible claims, one actual observed record supporting each, and one concrete question that could reconcile them. Acknowledge known uncertainty honestly; fabricated evidence does not qualify. A previously accepted identical pair of claims and evidence cannot pay another year. Materially new conflicting evidence can support a new submission, with the changed record identified. No real-player secret or belief is required.

Review and grace: the slot retains the actual paper in a visible accessible drawer. Within24elapsed hours of an available issuer receiving it, Veyr gives a numbered written receipt identifying the annual record and the three required fields. A timely submission remains provisionally timely during review. Rejection must name the absent or nonconflicting field. The claimant has10days from actual notice to correct it; a valid correction completed exactly at that deadline resolves before termination. Accepted correction satisfies only its identified annual record. Delayed review or grace never rebases later annual due dates. If more than one annual record is outstanding, each needs its own qualifying submission; one physical delivery may contain several statements.

Examples: one actual record says a sealed chamber was empty atnoon; another shows a named witness inside atnoon; the question asks whether either clock was misread. Or one actual published proof says all accepted gate keys are iron and also records an accepted glass key; the question asks which premise fails. Rain on one day and sun on another do not conflict. The examples teach the form; they are not fabricated observed records the claimant can submit unchanged.

Departure: the claimant may end future participation by an understood declaration to Veyr or a signed statement in the panel. If the current annual record has already been accepted and no earlier record remains unsatisfied, return the actual50gp bond and end the term. Otherwise the claimant may first satisfy those records, or choose immediate exit by forfeiting that50gp bond. This is the entire exit cost.
